evidence.snippet: Mycophenolate mofetil (MMF) is a prodrug of MPA that was developed to improve the bioavailability of MPA. After oral administration, MMF is completely metabolized to MPA.
evidence.explanation: MMF is a prodrug that is completely hydrolyzed to the active metabolite mycophenolic acid (MPA) after oral administration.

evidence.snippet: Mycophenolic acid (MPA) is a potent, selective, noncompetitive and reversible inhibitor of inosine-5'-monophosphate deshydrogenase (IMPDH).
evidence.explanation: MPA is a well-characterized potent inhibitor of IMPDH (type II isoform, UniProt P12268), the rate-limiting enzyme in de novo guanosine nucleotide biosynthesis.

evidence.snippet: Mycophenolic acid (MPA) is a highly selective, non-competitive and reversible inhibitor of the inosine monophosphate dehydrogenase (IMPDH), the rate-limiting enzyme in the de novo biosynthesis of guanosine nucleotides.
As T and B-lymphocytes almost exclusively use the de novo pathway of purine synthesis, these cells are particularly sensitive to the inhibitory action of MMF.
evidence.explanation: IMPDH catalyzes the rate-limiting step in de novo guanosine nucleotide synthesis, which T and B lymphocytes depend upon for proliferation; its activity thus positively regulates lymphocyte proliferation.

paper.title: [Pharmacological profiles of mycophenolate mofetil (CellCept), a new immunosuppressive agent].
paper.journal: Nihon yakurigaku zasshi. Folia pharmacologica Japonica

evidence.snippet: It preferentially inhibits denovo pathway of guanosine nucleotide synthesis in T and B-lymphocytes and prevents their proliferation, thereby suppresses both cell mediated and humoral immune responses.

paper.title: Mycophenolate mofetil: safety and efficacy in the prophylaxis of acute kidney transplantation rejection.

evidence.snippet: the number of immunoglobulin-producing B cells and serum levels of IgG and IgG anti-dsDNA antibodies were reduced after MMF and CYC treatment. MMF treatment significantly reduced the extent of deposition of C3 in glomeruli.
evidence.explanation: Lymphocyte proliferation drives production of pathogenic anti-dsDNA antibodies and immune complex/complement deposition in glomeruli in lupus nephritis; inhibiting lymphocyte proliferation with MMF reduces disease severity.

paper.title: Beneficial effect of the inosine monophosphate dehydrogenase inhibitor mycophenolate mofetil on survival and severity of glomerulonephritis in systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE)-prone MRLlpr/lpr mice.

evidence.snippet: since activated B lymphocytes play a central role in lupus and our results show that B cells are targets for MPA, we propose that direct effects on B cells may be an important mechanism for the ameliorating effects of MMF in SLE.

paper.title: Mycophenolic acid inhibits inosine 5'-monophosphate dehydrogenase and suppresses immunoglobulin and cytokine production of B cells.
